tagline.en: Buy free spins in Sweet, and Cross the Road got a full makeover.
tagline.id: Beli free spin di Sweet, dan Cross the Road tampil baru.

items.en: Sweet: buy 5, 10 or 15 free spins. Bombs drop far more often during free spins.
items.id: Sweet: beli 5, 10, atau 15 free spin. Bom jauh lebih sering muncul saat free spin.

items.en: Sweet has new hand-drawn candy, sparkle pops and Nice / Big / Mega win screens.
items.id: Sweet punya permen gambar baru, efek pecah berkilau, dan layar Lumayan / Big / Mega win.

items.en: Cross the Road: real cars, a hopping chicken, a camera that follows you. And it is much harder now.
items.id: Cross the Road: mobil asli, ayam melompat, kamera mengikuti. Dan sekarang jauh lebih sulit.

items.en: Neon Arcade is in beta: versions now show BETA.
items.id: Neon Arcade masih beta: versi sekarang tertulis BETA.
